title: Exercise 4. A decision table
html: Rule: "Light the left-clearance lamp when the left sector is 0.25 m or closer. If the left sector is unavailable, light the lamp." Write the table of cases for msg.left values 0.24, 0.25, 0.26, 1.00 and NaN, as in Section 7.1. Then say which comparison the rule needs for finite readings, < or <=.
